questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes Deployment Protection Rules?
options: Deployment protection rules create approval or policy gates before a job accesses a protected environment.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
questions.answer_key: Deployment protection rules create approval or policy gates before a job accesses a protected environment.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of deployment protection rules: Deployment protection rules create approval or policy gates before a job accesses a protected environment. Validate configuration and behavior against the current official reference before production use.
